overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Zurich 4 Person Barrel Sauna With Bronze Privacy View offers a luxurious outdoor retreat designed for relaxation and wellness. Crafted from Pacific Premium Cedar wood, this sauna comfortably accommodates four people, providing a serene environment to unwind and enjoy the benefits of muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. The sauna features a 6.0 kW stove with built-in controls, and an optional upgrade to an 8 kW stove, ensuring optimal heat distribution up to 190°F. Its bronze privacy tempered glass door and interior LED accent lighting create an inviting atmosphere, making it a perfect addition to your backyard oasis.
